facts.text: Maria has gone camping a few times but has not tried mountain climbing.

evidence.quote: I've gone camping a few times but never tried mountain climbing. Sounds thrilling though!

facts.text: John has gone camping plenty of times and finds it to be an awesome way to get away from it all and be at one with nature.

evidence.quote: Yeah, plenty of times. It's an awesome way to get away from it all and be at one with nature.

facts.text: Maria felt like she was in a fairy tale with calming water and beautiful surroundings.

evidence.quote: I felt like I was in a fairy tale! The water sounded so calming and the surroundings were beautiful.

facts.text: John believes that nature has a way of calming people down and helps them find peace amidst chaos.

evidence.quote: Wow, Maria, that sounds awesome! It seems like nature has a way of calming us down, huh?
